Two-group sample summary.viewText: Two-group sample summary2 rowsTwo-group MGA v4 reports Group A/Group B structural paths, R-squared values, outer loadings, outer weights, and A-minus-B differences. Inference uses a canonical deterministic two-tailed fixed partition plan shared with MICOM v4. Two-group permutation MGA v4 re-estimates paths, outer loadings, and outer weights using one fixed indexed size-preserving partition plan and reports two-tailed A-minus-B evidence without replacement retries. MICOM v4 uses the same fixed partition identities for Steps 2 and 3. Step 1 records explicit researcher review; translation, coding meaning, and substantive indicator equivalence are not inferred from data.Group columnRoleGroup valueAnalyzed observationsgroupGroup AA90groupGroup BB90Use the arrow keys to move between cells.
